name: app-lavender-ux-user-flow-challenge-solution-slide
title: Lavender UX Flow with Challenge and Solution Cards
whatItIs: A case-study slide with a soft lavender field, a title in two weights, tilted Challenge and Solution cards, a dashed arc and a rounded node flow diagram.
whatItMeans: Soft tone and gentle tilts make a UX explanation feel friendly. The paired cards deliver the story at a glance.
techniques: Two-weight title where the second line is faded
Tilted overlapping cards with icon status marks (warning, check)
Dashed curved line to lead the eye
Pill-shaped nodes joined by thin connectors
bestFor: Explaining a problem and its fix

vocabulary.definition: Two adjacent cards contrasting a problem with its answer.
A map of screens or steps a person moves through.
A title's second line set in a lighter tone.
